decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (eastern or western) walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans and the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, the existing front wall shall be permanently retained and the existing vehicle access shall not be enlarged or altered.

Condition : 8 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 50 Roxborough Avenue, Isleworth. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
description: Conversion of existing garage to habitable room and erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
